tasks.title: Fix pricing discount
tasks.brief:
Fix the single bug in /tmp/vcmp/w/t2/src/pricing.ts. You may edit ONLY that file.

The doc comment says: pct is a whole percentage: applyDiscount(1000, 10) === 900.

Current applyDiscount (the bug):
```
export function applyDiscount(cents: number, pct: number): number {
	return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct));
}
```
pct is a whole number (10 means 10%), but the code uses it as a fraction, so applyDiscount(1000, 10) returns Math.round(1000 * (1 - 10)) = -9000 instead of 900.

Change that return to:
```
	return Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100));
```

Do not change subtotal, tax, the LineItem interface, comments, or formatting beyond that one expression. Do not edit /tmp/vcmp/w/t2/test/pricing.test.ts or any other file. Do not run npm test.
